asOf: 17 November 2026, 7 pm IST, after the retention deadline
summary: Retentions are in. None of the ten top-rated batters and only one of the ten top-rated bowlers, Wanindu Hasaranga, was released. The Royals let Hetmyer and five seamers go and traded in Mohammed Shami, so the auction can buy pressure bowling from a deep pool, but not a crunch-tested middle-order batter.
confidence: Release and trade lists are as of 17 November 2026, 7 pm IST, from the ESPNcricinfo live blog [S14]. Purse and open-slot figures are as reported and can move with late trades.

needs.title: A pressure seamer beside Archer
needs.detail: Archer (21st of 64) is still the only Royals seamer in the top third. Shami, traded in, rates 37th, and five seamers were released. The pool holds three seamers ranked inside the top 20: Muzarabani 11th, Mustafizur 13th and Pathirana 20th.
needs.evidence: Primary: outputs/rankings/bowlers_all.csv. Release lists [S14]. Reviews asked for one more death-overs option [S7].

needs.title: A middle-order batter, scarce in the pool
needs.detail: With Hetmyer gone, the rated middle order is Parag 22nd, Shanaka 28th, Jurel 29th and Jadeja 34th of 35. No top-10 batter was released. The best released batter is Pathum Nissanka (17th), an opener, and the most tested middle-order option is Sikandar Raza (25th).
needs.evidence: Primary: outputs/rankings/batters_all.csv. Release lists [S14]. Reviews called the middle order the biggest issue [S7].

needs.title: Test the openers before paying for certainty
needs.detail: Sooryavanshi and Jaiswal have the two best usual levels in the squad but almost no High-pressure balls, because openers are out or home before the crunch. The data cannot say how they finish chases; it is not a reason to buy, but it is a reason not to assume.

targets.name: Wanindu Hasaranga
targets.why: 9th of 64 bowlers and the only top-20 player in the auction pool. 549 pressure balls, 75 in the High tier; would rank above Bishnoi as the Royals' best spinner.
targets.risk: Missed IPL 2026 injured; takes an overseas place; his own pressure lift was negative (-1.2), which section 5 shows does not predict the future.

targets.name: Blessing Muzarabani
targets.why: 11th of 64 bowlers, the highest-rated seamer in the pool and ahead of Archer. 35% chance of a true top-10 place; 48 High-tier balls.
targets.risk: Smaller IPL sample than most targets; takes an overseas place.

targets.name: Matheesha Pathirana
targets.why: 20th of 64 bowlers with 111 High-tier balls, among the most tested seamers in the pool, and a death-overs role in the data.
targets.risk: Fitness and workload history; overseas place; a lower rating than the two above.

targets.name: Pathum Nissanka
targets.fit: Top-order anchor; would have to bat at three or four here
targets.why: 17th of 35 batters (+4.3), the best-rated batter released. 842 pressure balls, 52 in the High tier.
targets.risk: An opener by trade, so he overlaps with Sooryavanshi and Jaiswal; overseas place.

targets.name: Sikandar Raza
targets.availability: In the pool: no IPL appearance since 2024 in the data
targets.why: 25th of 35 batters and 38th of 64 bowlers, tested in both (55 and 29 High-tier balls). The closest the pool comes to the middle-order gap.
targets.risk: Age; a modest rating; overseas place.

targets.name: Deepak Chahar
targets.why: 48th of 64 bowlers but Indian, so he leaves all three overseas places for Hasaranga, Muzarabani or Pathirana.

targets.name: Mustafizur Rahman
targets.availability: Released: by KKR [S14]; whether he can play IPL 2027 is unclear [S13]
targets.risk: The BCCI directed his release in January 2026 amid political tension [S13]; do not plan around him until his eligibility is confirmed.

caveats: Release and trade lists are as of 17 November 2026, 7 pm IST [S14]. Late trades before the auction can still change who is available.
Ratings measure how players performed in this data, 2022 to 2026. They do not account for price, age, fitness, or how a player fits the Jaipur pitch.
Hasaranga, Muzarabani and Pathirana are all overseas. The Royals have 3 overseas places, so buying all three uses every one; an Indian seamer such as Chahar keeps one free.
Data Pack facts take precedence over media reports. The purse and open-slot figures are reported, not confirmed by the IPL.
